english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: TOEFL iBT >= 81 (or >= 4.5 on updated TOEFL iBT scale for exams taken on/after Jan 21, 2026) or IELTS overall >= 6.5 (2021-22 sheet listed TOEFL PBT 550 / iBT 80-81 / IELTS 6-7). RHET 1020 exemption not stated.
english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.notes: Historical 2021-22 Fact Sheet figures at data/raw/factsheets/James Madison University/James Madison University Incoming Exchange Info Sheet 2021-2022 - Global Dukes.pdf#page=2.

fall_term_dates.value: Fall 2026: Classes Aug 26 - Dec 11, 2026; Final Exams Dec 12 - Dec 18, 2026 (Fall Break Oct 7-11; Thanksgiving Nov 23-27; orientation held the week prior per Fact Sheet p.2).
fall_term_dates.notes: Pre-term Fall orientation timing from data/raw/factsheets/James Madison University/James Madison University Incoming Exchange Info Sheet 2021-2022 - Global Dukes.pdf#page=2.

spring_term_dates.value: Spring 2027: Classes Jan 19 - May 5, 2027; Final Exams May 6 - May 12, 2027 (Spring Break Mar 15-19).
spring_term_dates.notes: Live inbound exchange portal (https://www.jmu.edu/global/abroad/exchange-students-inbound.shtml) lists regular Spring nomination/application deadlines (whereas 2021-22 PDF noted special-permission Spring entry).

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Derived from JMU official international cost breakdown ($15,088 living expenses + $4,300 books/personal = $19,388 academic year / 2 semesters = $9,694 per 5-month semester, i.e., $1,939/month). 2026-27 on-campus housing ($3,428-$4,228/sem) + resident meal plans ($3,438-$3,819/sem) + internet ($138/sem) listed at https://www.jmu.edu/ubo/undergraduate-tuition-rates.shtml.

living_cost_usd_est.notes: 1 USD = 1.0 USD on 2026-11-15 (native USD); 5-month semester estimate ($15,088 living + $4,300 books/personal = $19,388 annual / 2 semesters = $9,694 USD; 5 * $1,938.80/mo). Excludes tuition and health insurance.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Mandatory CISI health insurance: $1,656/year (split between fall and spring semesters; waivable only upon arrival with proven equivalent abroad coverage meeting U.S. Dept. of State rules). On-campus internet fee $138/semester (2026-27); 2021-22 sheet also noted $100/semester International Student Fee and $40 Housing Contract Fee.
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.notes: Internet fee ($138/sem) from https://www.jmu.edu/ubo/undergraduate-tuition-rates.shtml; legacy fee schedule in data/raw/factsheets/James Madison University/James Madison University Incoming Exchange Info Sheet 2021-2022 - Global Dukes.pdf#page=2.

housing_availability.notes: Housing preferences/contract coordinated during exchange onboarding and Office of Residential Life portal (rms.jmu.edu); no unconditional guarantee stated.

housing_notes.value: On-campus housing contract and preferences processed after acceptance via Residential Life (rms.jmu.edu). AY 2026-27 per-semester housing rates: $3,428-$4,228 (+$500 single occupancy) + $138 internet + mandatory resident meal plan ($3,438-$3,819/sem).

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: J-1 Exchange Visitor Visa (Form DS-2019 sent with acceptance packet). Financial evidence is a required initial application document ($53,250/yr international student COA total incl. $33,862 tuition/insurance, $15,088 living, $4,300 books/personal, $276 internet; exchange students document non-tuition living and fee support).
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.notes: International COA figure from https://www.jmu.edu/admissions/apply/international.shtml; acceptance-packet DS-2019 procedure in data/raw/factsheets/James Madison University/James Madison University Incoming Exchange Info Sheet 2021-2022 - Global Dukes.pdf#page=2.

english_course_list_url.notes: All JMU undergraduate courses in https://www.jmu.edu/catalog/courses/ are taught in English; no separate English-taught course list exists.

credit_system_and_load.value: US semester credit hours; J-1 visa compliance requires minimum 12 credits per semester in-person (approx. 4 courses).
credit_system_and_load.notes: Confirmed in data/raw/factsheets/James Madison University/James Madison University Incoming Exchange Info Sheet 2021-2022 - Global Dukes.pdf#page=2.

course_restrictions_note.value: Nursing, Medicine, Hospitality/Tourism Management, and College of Business (economics, finance, accounting, administration, management, marketing, etc.) are closed to exchange students. Preferred course list submitted at application, but specific enrollment is not guaranteed.
course_restrictions_note.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/James Madison University/James Madison University Incoming Exchange Info Sheet 2021-2022 - Global Dukes.pdf#page=2

value: Enrollment, housing, and JMU Honor Code signature documents
required_application_docs.notes: AY 2021-22 sheet (data/raw/factsheets/James Madison University/James Madison University Incoming Exchange Info Sheet 2021-2022 - Global Dukes.pdf#page=2) also listed a Letter of Recommendation.

academic_style.value: Public university in Virginia (~22,000 UG/GR students, ~4,000 faculty/staff) on a semester calendar with dedicated final exam week.
academic_style.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/James Madison University/James Madison University Incoming Exchange Info Sheet 2021-2022 - Global Dukes.pdf#page=1

international_support_services.value: JMU Center for Global Engagement advising, pre-semester orientation (1 week in Fall / 1 day in Spring), airport pickup from Washington Dulles International Airport (IAD), free English Language Learning Center tutoring, LIFE local-family connection program, Culture Nights, International Week, and career workshops.
international_support_services.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/James Madison University/James Madison University Incoming Exchange Info Sheet 2021-2022 - Global Dukes.pdf#page=1
international_support_services.notes: Orientation timing and IAD airport pickup details in data/raw/factsheets/James Madison University/James Madison University Incoming Exchange Info Sheet 2021-2022 - Global Dukes.pdf#page=2.

nomination_deadlines.value: Fall / Academic Year: Nomination March 1, Application April 1; Spring: Nomination October 1, Application November 1.
